title: 116-byte bucket record: INITENTRY of contract data keyed by SCV_EXECUTABLE_TAG, which Protocol 27 XDR cannot decode
why: A history-archive bucket holds every live ledger entry, including other people's contract data, so a catch-up reader decodes entries it never asked for. This record is the contract data entry created in cap-0085/contract-data-keyed-by-executable-tag, merged into a level 6 bucket: its key uses SCV_EXECUTABLE_TAG (ScVal arm 22, added in Protocol 28), and a decoder built on Protocol 27 XDR rejects it with an invalid-value error and cannot restore the checkpoint at all.

variants.notes: Record 31,241 (zero-based) of live bucket level 6 curr at testnet checkpoint 4378879, record mark 0x80000074. The archive object is vendored unmodified at objects/testnet/history-archive/4378879/ with the checkpoint's History Archive State and capture.json. byte_offset counts from the start of the gzip-decompressed bucket (whose sha256 is the bucket hash ab140ae5…a404) and points at the record mark; the blob is the record body that follows the 4-byte mark. Testnet is reset on 2026-12-16; its archive may then no longer serve this checkpoint.

values.note: The ledger of cap-0085/contract-data-keyed-by-executable-tag, where the entry was created.

known_divergences.detail: A catch-up client pinned to stellar-xdr 27.0.0 failed to restore checkpoint 4378879 with "Failed to parse bucket entry at offset 4483092: xdr value invalid" (BucketEntry::from_xdr); 27.0.0 has no SCV_EXECUTABLE_TAG arm.

notes: The record is an INITENTRY (BucketEntry arm 2): the entry was created within the ledgers merged into this bucket. The same bytes, as a LedgerEntry inside LedgerCloseMeta, are in cap-0085/contract-data-keyed-by-executable-tag (testnet ledger 4372189). The known divergence is the upstream report, not re-run here: the pinned stellar-xdr versions (28.0.0 and later) all decode the record. Byte offset 4483092 in the report is the offset of this record's mark in the decompressed bucket.
